dict.string: Shift uses your camera to take progress photos.
Shift uses on-device speech recognition when you choose to describe training preferences to the plan generator.
Shift uses the microphone only while you choose to dictate training preferences.
Shift reads only the Apple Health data needed for features you enable, such as activity, step goals, recovery guidance, body weight, workout history, calories, and heart rate.
Shift saves completed workouts and body-weight entries to Apple Health when you enable those sync options.
Shift uses Face ID to protect your progress photos.
